scope: Re-consume an already stored REAL32 source endpoint through the maintained store primitive. This does not reproduce the primitive source-candidate producer and is not an airflow/model-chain replay.
compiler_profile: Pinned Intel ifx from tests/intel_toolchain.sh; O0 audit flags and O2 reproduce flags; strict FP, no FTZ.

exact_rational_margins.definition: M = N*rho; lower = volume_min*Q; upper = volume_max*Q. Stored-consumer check requires both REAL64 M and REAL32-rounded M to lie in [lower, upper]. Fractions are exact rationals of the represented IEEE input bits.

conclusion: With these supplied source-endpoint bits and bounds, the volume-enabled call passes without changing Q. This endpoint probe does not establish what happened at the primitive producer; the separate captured candidate replay is the source-bound evidence.
